title: Notch Armor
description: The most cursed armor and tools that you can get.
body:
Inspired by MiSteaken's YouTube video: [The Greatest Armor in Minecraft History: Notch Armor](https://youtu.be/N_8pupgkw-E?si=HZOLCJM6QB_1QHFd)

I did not want to downgrade my current hard core play through to obtain this set of armor, so I created a datapack that will allow the crafting of this armor.  Just drop this datapack into your datapack folder of your world can follow the crafting recipe to create your own copy of the armor.
